title: Descent data for a singleton fpqc cover remain fully faithful after a refinement
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:X'\to S$ be morphisms such that both singleton families are fpqc coverings [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and let $h:X'\to X$ be a morphism over $S$ with $g=f\circ h$. Pulling a descent datum $(V,\varphi)$ on a scheme $V$ over $X/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum] back along $h$ gives a descent datum over $X'/S$. The resulting pullback functor from descent data over $X/S$ to descent data over $X'/S$ is fully faithful: for any two data, compatible morphisms between their pullbacks arise uniquely from a compatible morphism between the original data.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02W0 (lemma-refine-coverings-fully-faithful, line 8858), last sentence, specialized to singleton fpqc coverings and a refinement $X'\to X$

proof.text: Set $X''=X'\times_SX$, with projections $p:X''\to X$ and $q:X''\to X'$. The map $p$ is the base change of $g$ and $q$ is the base change of $f$, so both singleton families are fpqc coverings by [lem-galois-fpqc-covering-base-change] (for $p$, applied with $U=X$ and the covering $\{g\}$, after identifying $X'\times_SX$ with $X\times_SX'$ by the symmetry isomorphism of [def-pc-fibre-product]; composing a singleton fpqc covering with an isomorphism of its source gives an fpqc covering, directly from [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]).

source.place: Tag 022D(3), base change of fpqc coverings

proof.text: Apply [lem-galois-fpqc-singleton-fully-faithful-0241] to the singleton coverings $p$ and $q$ from Step 1. Thus $F_p:DD(X/S)\to DD(X''/S)$ and $F_q:DD(X'/S)\to DD(X''/S)$ are fully faithful, hence $F_q$ is faithful. The maps $p$ and $h\circ q$ from $X''$ to $X$ are over $S$; [lem-galois-fpqc-pullback-canonical-iso] identifies their pullback functors, and its composition clause identifies pullback along $h\circ q$ with $F_q\circ F_h$. Therefore $F_p\cong F_q\circ F_h$ naturally.

source.place: Tag 02W0 proof via Tags 0241, 02VS(3) and 023Y, common-refinement pullback comparison

proof.text: For any two data $A,B$ and morphism $u:F_hA\to F_hB$, fullness of $F_p\cong F_qF_h$ from Step 2 lifts $F_q(u)$ to a morphism $v:A\to B$. Faithfulness of $F_q$ gives $F_h(v)=u$. If $F_h(v)=F_h(w)$, then $F_p(v)=F_p(w)$ under the same isomorphism, so faithfulness of $F_p$ gives $v=w$. Hence $F_h$ is fully faithful.
